record.field: # Informational calculation rule: monetary amount is 0.0 JOD so it does not alter basic pay result = 0.0
net_var = round(payslip.attendance_net_reconciled, 2) if payslip else 0.0 result = net_var > 0.01
# Overtime is banked to Extra Hours, NOT paid on monthly cash salary (0.0 JOD) # HR can pay banked extra hours anytime via Salary Inputs result = 0.0
cash_hrs = round(payslip.undertime_cash_deduction_hours, 2) if payslip else 0.0 result = cash_hrs >= 0.01

deficit_hours = round(payslip.undertime_cash_deduction_hours, 2) if payslip else 0.0 if deficit_hours < 0.01: result = 0.0 else: emp = payslip.employee_id if payslip else None w = emp.wage if emp else 0.0 hourly_rate = w / 240.0 result = -(deficit_hours * hourly_rate)
